title: 第685章 暴虐重甲虫兵第684章 胡布里斯的任务清单
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 蜜儿菲菈看着自信而傲慢的胡布里斯，心中愈发的焦躁不安。
这是生物的天性，一种对未来的焦虑，也是危险来临前求生的意志。
胡布里斯这种泯灭人性的家伙真的会让她的虫群发展起来吗？胡布里斯还有不少事情瞒着她，完全就是将她的虫群当做工具使用，也不顾及蜜儿菲菈的死活。
她还没有让虫群撕碎咒怨，不能在此之前让胡布里斯玩死……
“你不会背叛的吧？”蜜儿菲菈凝视着胡布里斯。
胡布里斯用眼角余光瞥视着蜜儿菲菈，就这么蔑视着她。
“果然啊，胡布里斯你打心底瞧不起我，你的计划里，我和我的虫群还有生存下来的绝对保证吗？”蜜儿菲菈质问着胡布里斯。
在胡布里斯回答之前，她拿出了两块质感不同的甲壳。
魔力注入后，一块甲壳发出淡淡的微光，另一块则完全通透明亮。
“我的孩子们以树木为食，身体发生变异，仅仅一周，对魔力的适应性就有了显著变化。”
胡布里斯笑了：“结果真是令人大开眼界，果然进化出了脑子。”
蜜儿菲菈盯着胡布里斯：“我要你发誓。”
“好，我发誓，你们还有研究价值，我在你们身上的研究课题还没结束，你们不会覆灭在此次课题里。”
胡布里斯相当随意，誓言对他来说不算什么，也没有任何约束力。不过以胡布里斯的性格，他不屑于违背自己说过的话。
正是了解这点，蜜儿菲菈反而安心下来，心中的紧迫感也消失了。
看她放松下来，胡布里斯伸手，拍了拍蜜儿菲菈的肩膀：“但现在，需要虫群奉献的时候来了。”
蜜儿菲菈看着胡布里斯的笑容，吞咽了一口唾沫。
咕噜咕噜咕噜~喉结鼓动。
烤肉宴上，姆莉大口喝着果汁，然后露出一脸满足的表情。
“嗨嗨嗨！吃~饱~啦！嗝~”
夏提拉温和地笑着，看姆莉嘴角沾着果子，拿着手帕帮她轻轻擦拭。
轰隆一声。
唐小队众人迅速转头，手上的动作相当稳定，打汤的打汤，倒果汁的倒果汁。
反而是刚来的教会成员与圣骑士被吓到，还有人不小心洒了汤。
“又来伐木？我们走吧。”唐放下食物，起身走向边吃苹果边教育狮鹫们的灰龙。
“等等！唐先生，请给我们表现的机会！”圣骑士团长快速骑上狮鹫。
桑索菲亚见状，也开口道：“虫群数量太多，如果可以更加分散地去伐木，一定会分兵剿灭虫群，总有几处战场完全依靠他们。”
唐简单思索两秒，点头答应：“好吧，那我不出手，就在一旁督战。”
骑士团长欣喜点头，招呼了一些人手：“准备好了吗孩子们？”
“准备好了团长！”
“在唐先生面前表现的时候到了！骑上狮鹫，出发！”
“剿恶伐罪！”圣骑士们气势高涨，动作整齐划一。
看这严明的军纪，果然是一支强兵啊。
唐很满意友军的数值，又看同伴们：“汤且温着，我去去就回。”
众人点头，对于唐他们的行动颇为放心。这么多圣骑士在，哪怕大罪亲临也丝毫不惧。
目送唐和圣骑士远去，剩余的人继续自己的事情。该吃吃该喝喝。
content_en:
Milfila looked at the confident and arrogant Hubris, and her heart became increasingly restless.
This is the nature of living things, an anxiety about the future, and the will to survive before danger comes.
Would someone as inhumane as Hubris really allow her insect swarm to develop? Hubris still kept a lot of things from her. He just used her insect swarm as a tool and didn't care about Milfila's life or death.
She hasn't let the insect swarm tear up the curse yet, and she can't let Hubris play to death before that...
"You won't betray, right?" Milfila stared at Hubris.
Hubris glanced at Milfila from the corner of his eye, scorning her like this.
"As expected, Hubris, you look down on me from the bottom of your heart. In your plan, is there an absolute guarantee that my insect swarm and I will survive?" Milfila asked Hubris.
Before Hubris could answer, she took out two carapace pieces with different textures.
After the magic power was injected, one piece of the carapace glowed faintly, while the other piece became completely transparent and bright.
"My children ate trees and their bodies mutated. In just one week, there was a significant change in their adaptability to magic."
Hubris smiled: "The results are really eye-opening. Sure enough, a brain has evolved."
Milfila stared at Hubris: "I want you to swear."
"Okay, I swear, you still have research value. My research project on you is not over yet, and you will not be destroyed in this project."
Hubris was quite casual. The oath was nothing to him and had no binding force. However, given Hubris's character, he did not bother to go against what he had said.
Knowing this, Milfila felt at ease, and the sense of urgency in her heart disappeared.
Seeing her relax, Hubris reached out and patted Melfila on the shoulder: "But now, the time has come when we need the dedication of the insect swarm."
Milfila looked at Hubris's smile and swallowed.
Gulu gulu gulu~ The Adam's apple is bulging.
At the barbecue banquet, Muli drank a lot of juice and showed a satisfied expression.
"Hey, hey, hey! Eat~full~! Burp~"
Shatila smiled gently, seeing the fruit on the corner of Mli's mouth, and wiped it gently with her handkerchief.
There was a boom.
Everyone in Tang's team quickly turned their heads, and the movements of their hands were quite steady. Those who were making soup were pouring soup, and those who were pouring juice were pouring juice.
Instead, the newly arrived church members and paladins were frightened, and some accidentally spilled the soup.
"Coming to cut wood again? Let's go." Tang put down the food, stood up and walked towards the gray dragon who was eating apples and educating the griffins.
"Wait! Mr. Tang, please give us a chance to show off!" The leader of the Holy Knights quickly mounted the griffin.
Seeing this, Sansofia also spoke: "There are too many insect swarms. If we can cut trees more dispersedly, we will definitely divide our troops to destroy the insect swarms. There will always be several battlefields that completely rely on them."
Tang Jian thought for two seconds and nodded in agreement: "Okay, then I won't take action and will just supervise the battle from the side."
The knight leader nodded happily and called some people: "Are you ready, children?"
"Ready Captain!"
"The time has come to show off in front of Mr. Tang! Mount the gryphon and set off!"
"Suppress evil and conquer crime!" The Paladins were full of momentum and moved in unison.
Looking at this strict military discipline, it is indeed a strong army.
Tang was very satisfied with the numbers of his friendly troops and looked at his companions: "The soup is still warm. I'll be back soon."
Everyone nodded, feeling quite relieved about Tang's actions. There are so many holy knights here, even if the great sin comes in person, they are not afraid at all.
Watching Tang and the Paladin go away, the remaining people continued their own affairs. Eat and drink when you should.
